question: Who among the following became the first Indian javelin thrower to win an Asian Games gold medal in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra became the first Indian javelin thrower to win an Asian Games gold medal in 2018**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an Indian track and field athlete who competes in the Javelin throw.

 
 
• He is ranked second by World Athletics(as of August 2021).
 
• Chopra is the first track and field athlete to win a gold medal for India at the Olympics.
 
• Achievements: IAAF World U20 Championships- in 2016 he achieved a world under-20 record throw of 86.48m, In the 2020 Tokyo Olympics Chopra won a gold medal on 7th August 2021.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
